# INA2XX Current/Power Monitor

# Copyright 2021 The Chromium OS Authors
# Copyright 2021 Grinn
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

config INA2XX
	bool "INA2XX Current/Power Monitor"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA226_ENABLED || DT_HAS_TI_INA230_ENABLED || \
		   DT_HAS_TI_INA236_ENABLED || DT_HAS_TI_INA237_ENABLED || \
		   DT_HAS_TI_INA228_ENABLED
	select I2C
	help
	  Enable driver for INA2XX Current/Power Monitor.

if INA2XX

config INA2XX_TRIGGER
	bool

config INA230
	bool "INA230"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA230_ENABLED || DT_HAS_TI_INA236_ENABLED
	help
	  Enable driver for INA230/INA236.

config INA230_TRIGGER
	bool "INA230 trigger mode"
	depends on INA230 && GPIO && $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_TI_INA230),alert-gpios)
	select INA2XX_TRIGGER
	help
	  Enable trigger mode for INA230.

config INA237
	bool "INA237"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA237_ENABLED
	help
	  Enable driver for INA237.

config INA237_VSHUNT
	bool "INA237 VSHUNT channel"
	depends on INA237
	help
	  Enable VSHUNT channel for INA237.

config INA237_TRIGGER
	bool "INA237 trigger mode"
	depends on INA237 && GPIO && $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_TI_INA237),alert-gpios)
	select INA2XX_TRIGGER
	help
	  Enable trigger mode for INA237.

config INA226
	bool "INA226"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA226_ENABLED
	help
	  Enable driver for INA226.

config INA226_VSHUNT
	bool "INA226 VSHUNT channel"
	depends on INA226
	help
	  Enable VSHUNT channel for INA226.

config INA228
	bool "INA228"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA228_ENABLED
	help
	  Enable driver for INA228.

config INA228_VSHUNT
	bool "INA228 VSHUNT channel"
	depends on INA228
	help
	  Enable VSHUNT channel for INA228.

config INA228_TRIGGER
	bool "INA228 trigger mode"
	depends on INA228 && GPIO && $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_TI_INA228),alert-gpios)
	select INA2XX_TRIGGER
	help
	  Enable trigger mode for INA228.

if INA2XX_TRIGGER

config INA2XX_THREAD_PRIORITY
	int "Thread priority"
	default 10
	help
	  Priority of thread used by the driver to handle interrupts.

config INA2XX_THREAD_STACK_SIZE
	int "Thread stack size"
	default 1024
	help
	  Stack size of thread used by the driver to handle interrupts.

endif # INA2XX_TRIGGER

config EMUL_INA230
	bool "Emulate an INA230"
	default y
	depends on EMUL
	depends on INA230
	help
	  It provides readings which follow a simple sequence, thus allowing
	  test code to check that things are working as expected.

config EMUL_INA237
	bool "Emulate an INA237"
	default y
	depends on EMUL
	depends on INA237
	help
	  It provides readings which follow a simple sequence, thus allowing
	  test code to check that things are working as expected.

endif # INA2XX
